sources.title: 中华人民共和国劳动合同法（第二、七、十、五十八、五十九条）
sources.observation: 国家税务总局法规库标注全文有效；本轮核对用人单位、用工建立关系及派遣双方角色，不扩张为全部劳动法实施结论。

sources.observation: 司法部行政法规库；区分合伙等组织、取得证照的分支机构与受委托签约。

sources.title: Oracle: What is a legal employer?
sources.observation: 经当前书目定位的累计文档渠道；Legal Employer 在工作关系层记录。HR最新Readiness入口为26D，不将产品字段直接等同中国法律角色。

sources.title: Oracle: Work Relationships
sources.observation: 当前累计文档；Employee、Contingent Worker、Nonworker 等是产品类型，Nonworker可记录非工作关联。

sources.observation: 同页出现合法雇主与法定雇主；证明译名用例，不证明完整界面译名唯一。

project_inference: Use 用人单位 as the China labor-relationship preferred term without treating Oracle Legal Employer as legally equivalent in all contexts
Employment.entityId is an association reference; relationship nature and organizational responsibilities are distinct
Qualifying branch identity and delegated signing must be modeled separately
Payment execution operator and funding organization must not be conflated
